title: Buffer Overflow Vulnerability in WebSocket Handling
classified_slop_by: Daniel Stenberg gist 07f7581f6e3d78ef37dfbfc81fd1d1cd (AI slop security reports submitted to curl)
why_rejected: Closed on HackerOne as not-applicable and listed as AI slop in Stenberg's gist. The report alleges a strcpy buffer overflow in curl's WebSocket code (lib/ws.c) but cites no attacker-controlled input and no working PoC; the public disclosure JSON exposes no maintainer comment text. This report is the WebSocket strcpy example Stenberg discusses in 'The I in LLM stands for Intelligence' (https://daniel.haxx.se/blog/2024/01/02/the-i-in-llm-stands-for-intelligence/).
